title: Proof of Delivery Report Form
subtitle: Proof Of Delivery: reconciles results, variances, and follow-up.
description: Proof of Delivery Report Form covers delivered unit, recipient, delivery point, timestamp, condition, and privacy-conscious proof. The delivery verification coordinator records Proof Of Delivery source records, totals, variance, and distribution. Proof of Delivery Report Form keeps Proof Of Delivery exceptions visible until the delivery verification coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Proof of Delivery Report Form at destination address, authorized delivery point, vehicle, and custody handoff. Document delivered unit, recipient, delivery point, timestamp, condition, and privacy-conscious proof identity before Proof Of Delivery begins. Compare delivered unit, recipient, delivery point, timestamp, condition, and privacy-conscious proof findings with stated Proof Of Delivery criteria; route unresolved Proof Of Delivery issues to delivery evidence reviewer.

sections.title: Source records and reporting context
sections.guidance: For Proof Of Delivery, identify responsible parties, destination address, authorized delivery point, vehicle, and custody handoff, and the linked delivered unit, recipient, delivery point, timestamp, condition, and privacy-conscious proof source.

fields.label: Piece, package, serial, seal, and quantity
Recipient, organization, authority, and delivery-point identity

sections.title: Report lines and recipient controls
sections.guidance: Capture Proof Of Delivery facts for delivered unit, recipient, delivery point, timestamp, condition, and privacy-conscious proof; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Proof Of Delivery report checks
items: Signature, photograph, scan, or other permitted proof
Refusal, unattended delivery, or failed-attempt basis

sections.title: Reconciled outcome and reviewer acknowledgment
sections.guidance: Resolve open Proof Of Delivery conditions; have delivery verification coordinator assign the next Proof Of Delivery owner and transfer its retained record.

blocks.label: Reconciliation exceptions and retained evidence
items: Proof collection would exceed privacy policy
blocks.guidance: Pause Proof Of Delivery when recipient, location, custody, condition, or permitted proof remains unresolved. Retain the available Proof Of Delivery proof and route unresolved delivered unit, recipient, delivery point, timestamp, condition, and privacy-conscious proof scope to delivery verification coordinator.
